Examples of evidence that would NOT trigger this exception: - "The bank will not finance new and existing coal power plants."

mitigant_examples: Examples of evidence for this mitigant: - "The bank will not provide finance for expansion via corporate mergers and acquisition unless the client has confirmed phase-out of these assets will be line with the bank's 2030/40 timelines."

exception_examples: Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "The bank will not participate in project finance for unabated fossil fuels." - "The financing of coal plant modernisation projects is assessed case-by-case, including life extension, decommissioning and conversion, pollution-control retrofits, and Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage (CCUS)." - "Expansions are allowed if retrofitting reduces greenhouse gas emissions."
Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "Expansions are permitted if contractually committed (e.g. via PPA) or already under construction before 1 January 2021."

Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: - "Only coal power projects above 300 MW are restricted" - "Coal plants dedicated to specific industrial projects (e.g. aluminium smelters, steel mills) are excluded from the restriction" - "exempted activities include captive coal power plants."
Examples of evidence that would trigger this exception: "expansion refers only to increases of more than 10% in net coal power capacity."
